theme.en: AI Hardware Gains Depend on Integration and Execution
theme.zh: AI硬件性能取决于系统整合与执行

dek.en: Vera software tuning, MicroLED interconnect evaluation and HBM system design put the focus on how components work together. Manufacturing expansion and Nvidia's talent and export-oversight developments add execution questions beyond chip specifications.
dek.zh: Vera的软件优化、MicroLED互连评估和HBM系统设计，将焦点引向各个部件如何协同工作。制造环节扩张，以及英伟达的人才与出口监督动态，也带来了芯片规格之外的执行问题。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia Reports Nearly 39% Vera CPU Gains From Software Tuning
title.zh: 英伟达称软件优化可使Vera CPU在特定负载下提速近39%

summary.en: Nvidia demonstrated at SC26 that software optimization can improve its Vera CPU's performance by nearly 39% on certain workloads, according to Tom's Hardware. Vera uses custom Olympus Arm cores, making architecture-specific tuning an important part of realizing its performance. The reported uplift applies to selected workloads rather than a general improvement across applications.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，英伟达在SC26展示，软件优化可让Vera CPU在特定工作负载下的性能提升近39%。Vera采用定制Olympus Arm核心，因此针对微架构的软件调优，是发挥硬件性能的重要环节。这一增幅对应所展示的特定负载，不能直接推广到所有应用。

title.en: Nvidia Employee Letter Warns of Departures Without Huang's Return
title.zh: 英伟达员工致信董事会，警告黄仁勋不复职可能引发人才流失

summary.en: An internal letter to Nvidia's board and senior executives warns that irreplaceable staff could leave unless Jensen Huang is reinstated as CEO, Tom's Hardware reports. The warning adds employee retention to the company's leadership dispute, with potential implications for engineering continuity. It describes a risk of departures, rather than confirming that an exodus has occurred.
summary.zh: Tom's Hardware报道，一封发给英伟达董事会和高管的内部信警告，若黄仁勋未获恢复CEO职务，部分难以替代的人才可能离职。这使领导层争议进一步涉及员工留任，并可能影响工程研发的连续性。信中提出的是人才流失风险，并不代表大规模离职已经发生。

title.en: Intel and Altera Build FPGA Sensor Bridges for Edge AI
title.zh: 英特尔与Altera开发面向边缘AI的FPGA传感器桥接方案

summary.en: Intel and Altera developed reference solutions combining Intel processors and software with FPGA hardware for real-time sensor integration. Programmable bridging gives edge AI designers a way to adapt sensor interfaces and data paths to application requirements. The announcement concerns reference solutions, rather than a disclosed production deployment.
summary.zh: 英特尔与Altera开发了参考方案，将英特尔处理器及软件与FPGA硬件结合，用于实时传感器集成。可编程桥接使边缘AI设计者能够按应用需求调整传感器接口和数据通路。此次发布的是参考方案，尚非已披露的量产部署。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: GlobalFoundries Starts New Fab Project in New York's Capital Region
title.zh: 格芯在纽约州首府地区启动新晶圆厂项目

summary.en: GlobalFoundries has kicked off a new semiconductor fab project in New York's Capital Region, Business Facilities reports. The project signals further investment in the region's manufacturing base. A project launch precedes production, so it should not be counted as capacity already available to customers.
summary.zh: 据Business Facilities报道，格芯在纽约州首府地区启动了一个新的半导体晶圆厂项目。这表明当地的芯片制造基地继续吸引新增投资。项目启动与正式投产仍有距离，不能将其视为客户已经可以使用的产能。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: HBM4 Bandwidth Gains Put System Design in Focus
title.zh: HBM4带宽提升，让系统设计成为关键

summary.en: A SemiWiki analysis argues that faster HBM alone cannot determine the performance of next-generation AI accelerators. HBM4 widens the interface and increases available bandwidth, while custom HBM opens opportunities to optimize the memory-to-accelerator connection. The implication for designers is to assess memory as part of the complete system rather than use peak bandwidth as a proxy for application performance.
summary.zh: SemiWiki的一篇分析指出，仅提高HBM速度，无法决定下一代AI加速器的实际性能。HBM4通过加宽接口提高可用带宽，定制HBM则为优化存储与加速器之间的连接提供了空间。对设计者而言，需要把存储放在完整系统中评估，不能直接用峰值带宽代替应用性能。

title.en: Equipment, Materials & Packaging
title.zh: 设备、材料与封装

title.en: Polar Light and Foxconn Evaluate 5-µm MicroLED Optical Links
title.zh: Polar Light与富士康评估5微米MicroLED光互连

summary.en: Polar Light and Foxconn signed an agreement to evaluate 5-µm green MicroLED emitters for optical connectivity in AI data centers and computing systems. The work explores another emitter technology for moving data between computing components. It remains an evaluation program, with no commercial deployment established by the announcement.
summary.zh: Polar Light与富士康签署协议，将评估用于AI数据中心和计算系统光互连的5微米绿色MicroLED发光器件。这项工作探索以另一类发光器件技术，在计算部件之间传输数据。目前双方仍处于评估阶段，公告尚未确立商业部署。

title.en: FPT Begins Trial Operations at Vietnam Packaging and Test Plant
title.zh: FPT越南封装测试工厂开始试运行

summary.en: FPT started trial operations at its chip testing and packaging facility in Bac Ninh, Vietnam. The plant has six production lines and designed annual capacity of 300 million chips, targeting domestic and international customers. Trial operation advances the facility toward customer production, but the design figure is not a measure of current output.
summary.zh: FPT位于越南北宁的芯片测试与封装工厂开始试运行。该厂设有6条生产线，设计年产能为3亿颗芯片，面向国内外客户。试运行推动工厂向客户量产交付迈进，但设计产能并不等于当前实际产量。

title.en: Equipment Market Forecast Points to $372 Billion by 2033
title.zh: 市场研究预测半导体设备市场2033年达3720亿美元

summary.en: MarketsandMarkets forecasts that the semiconductor equipment market will reach $372 billion by 2033, with annual growth of 10.6%, EE Times Asia reports. Its demand drivers include advanced logic, memory, AI chips and packaging investment. This is a third-party market projection rather than reported equipment orders or supplier guidance.
summary.zh: 据EE Times Asia报道，MarketsandMarkets预测半导体设备市场到2033年将达到3720亿美元，年增长率为10.6%。该机构将先进逻辑、存储、AI芯片和封装投资列为需求驱动力。这属于第三方市场预测，并非已经落地的设备订单或供应商业绩指引。

title.en: Policy & Export Oversight
title.zh: 政策与出口监督

title.en: Nvidia Creates Committee for National Security and Chip Exports
title.zh: 英伟达设立委员会，监督国家安全与芯片出口事务

summary.en: Nvidia created a committee to oversee national-security and chip-export matters, TechTarget reports. The move adds a dedicated oversight mechanism for decisions affecting access to its chips. Establishing the committee is a corporate governance action and does not itself change government export permissions.
summary.zh: 据TechTarget报道，英伟达设立了一个委员会，监督国家安全及芯片出口相关事务。此举为影响其芯片市场准入的决策增加了专门监督机制。设立委员会属于公司治理举措，本身并不改变政府的出口许可。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Cerebras Launches Disaggregated Inference
title.zh: Cerebras推出分离式推理

summary.en: Cerebras announced the launch of disaggregated inference. Separating inference stages allows their compute resources to be provisioned independently, offering another deployment model for specialized AI hardware. The launch announcement alone does not establish a workload-independent speed or cost advantage.
summary.zh: Cerebras宣布推出分离式推理。将推理阶段拆分后，可以分别配置各阶段的计算资源，为专用AI硬件提供另一种部署方式。仅凭发布消息，尚不能确定其在不同工作负载下都具备速度或成本优势。

theme.en: Execution Paths Set the Cost of AI
theme.zh: 执行路径决定AI计算成本

dek.en: Eight preprints examine reproducible FP4 training, GPU storage access, network-aware execution and inference efficiency. Their results connect hardware utilization to numerical methods and scheduling, with benefits bounded by the tested models and deployment conditions.
dek.zh: 本期8篇预印本涵盖可复现FP4训练、GPU存储访问、面向网络拓扑的执行方式和推理效率。研究将硬件利用率与数值方法、调度方式联系起来，相关收益仍需结合所测试的模型和部署条件理解。

title.en: Accelerator Systems & Interconnects
title.zh: 加速器系统与互连

title.en: GNoF: GPU-Native NVMe-over-Fabrics With Lower Polling Overhead
title.zh: GNoF：降低轮询开销的GPU原生NVMe-oF数据通路

summary.en: GNoF moves NVMe-oF/RDMA command construction, submission and completion handling onto the GPU, retaining CPU involvement for connection setup and administrative tasks. It batches doorbell updates and completion polling to reduce the SM time consumed while waiting through 10–100 microsecond fabric round trips. This targets a practical cost of GPU-initiated remote storage: freeing the CPU is insufficient if storage waits occupy GPU compute resources.
summary.zh: GNoF将NVMe-oF/RDMA命令构造、提交和完成处理移到GPU上，CPU仍负责连接初始化和管理任务。系统批量处理门铃更新与完成队列轮询，以减少等待10至100微秒网络往返时占用的SM资源。这项工作针对GPU主动访问远程存储的一项实际代价：若存储等待持续占用GPU计算资源，仅释放CPU还不够。

title.en: Bipartible Routes HTTP Storage Requests Through InfiniBand
title.zh: Bipartible将HTTP存储请求导向InfiniBand

papers.authors: Richard Henwood, John Lockman, Luke Wilson

summary.en: The Bipartible architecture places clones of a global HTTP service on HPC compute hosts so storage requests can use the InfiniBand network without modifying workload code or network configuration. It addresses the mismatch between cloud-native HTTP applications and clusters whose high-performance storage fabric is separate from TCP networking. The approach assumes the persistent storage is reachable over InfiniBand, so its applicability depends on the cluster layout.
summary.zh: Bipartible架构在HPC计算主机上部署全局HTTP服务的副本，让存储请求利用InfiniBand网络，而无需修改工作负载代码或网络配置。它针对云原生HTTP应用与HPC集群之间的适配问题，后者的高性能存储网络通常独立于TCP网络。该方法要求持久化存储可通过InfiniBand访问，因此适用范围取决于集群布局。

title.en: Network-Native DNN Synthesis Designs Around Physical Topology
title.zh: 面向物理网络拓扑合成分布式DNN架构

papers.authors: Fan Yang, Xiaolong Wu, Qi Cao, et al.

summary.en: LPAS synthesizes a distributed DNN architecture from the physical network topology under communication, compute, storage, synchronization and latency constraints. Across the evaluated networks, the authors report gaps below 0.6% to an LP-derived upper bound and lower runtime than direct mixed-integer optimization. This gives designers a way to fit neural computation to available infrastructure, although proximity to an optimization bound does not establish model accuracy.
summary.zh: LPAS在通信、计算、存储、同步和延迟约束下，依据物理网络拓扑合成分布式DNN架构。作者报告，在所测试的网络上，求解结果与线性规划推导的上界相差不到0.6%，运行时间也低于直接采用混合整数优化的方法。这为按现有基础设施安排神经网络计算提供了路径，但接近优化上界并不等于已经证明模型精度。

title.en: AI Training, Architectures & Inference
title.zh: AI训练、架构与推理

title.en: CertiSum Makes MXFP4 Training Bitwise Identical Across GPUs
title.zh: CertiSum实现跨GPU平台的MXFP4训练逐比特一致

papers.authors: Steve Rhyner, Yubo Gao, Stefan de Lasa, et al.

summary.en: CertiSum certifies when native FP32 accumulation of MXFP4 products is exact and recomputes uncertified results, while keeping quantization blocks and partial-sum merging invariant across layouts. In 200-step Qwen3-8B-Base experiments, training states matched bit for bit across AMD MI350X and Nvidia GB200 and across parallelism changes on MI350X. Across three 8B–14B models, the reported training-step latency overhead was 11.8–60.5% versus non-exact MXFP4, making reproducibility an explicit performance trade-off.
summary.zh: CertiSum验证原生FP32累加MXFP4乘积何时能够保持精确，对未通过验证的结果重新精确计算，并使量化块和部分和合并不随并行布局改变。在Qwen3-8B-Base的200步实验中，AMD MI350X与英伟达GB200上的训练状态逐比特一致，在MI350X上改变并行方式也保持一致。对3个80亿至140亿参数模型，作者报告相较非精确MXFP4，单步训练延迟增加11.8%至60.5%，说明可复现性需要付出明确的性能代价。

title.en: Multimodal Serving Measures Energy Costs of Stage Separation
title.zh: 多模态推理研究量化阶段拆分的能耗收益与延迟代价

papers.authors: Yifan Sun, Jiantong Jiang, Zhexiang Zhang, et al.

summary.en: Across four multimodal models with a fixed three-GPU budget, separating visual encoding, prefill and decode reduced GPU energy per successful request by 13.3–37.0% at nearly unchanged output-token throughput, but increased mean time to first token. Across the evaluated workloads, uniform downclocking to 80% reduced GPU energy by 11.7–18.6% with modest changes in mean latency. The measurements show why stage-level power savings must be evaluated with pipeline queueing and request latency, rather than power alone.
summary.zh: 在固定使用3颗GPU、测试4个多模态模型的条件下，将视觉编码、预填充和解码拆分，使每个成功请求的GPU能耗降低13.3%至37.0%，输出词元吞吐量基本不变，但平均首词元延迟上升。在所测试的负载中，统一降频至80%可使GPU能耗降低11.7%至18.6%，平均延迟变化较小。这些测量说明，评估单个阶段的节电收益时，需要同时考虑流水线排队与请求延迟，不能只看功率。

title.en: Balanced Twin Factorization Reuses Shared Computation in MLLMs
title.zh: 平衡孪生权重分解复用多模态大模型中的共享计算

papers.authors: Bryan A. Plummer, Shan Lu, Keval Doshi, et al.

summary.en: Balanced Twin Weight Factorization reuses a single shared-basis forward pass when factorized layers receive the same input. Its balancing mechanism aims to prevent larger layers from dominating the shared representation when the paired layers have different sizes. The method targets the gap between reducing FLOPs and reducing actual latency, where multiple small matrix operations can otherwise erase compression benefits.
summary.zh: 平衡孪生权重分解在多个分解层接收相同输入时，只执行一次共享基矩阵的前向计算并复用结果。当成对的层尺寸不同时，其平衡机制旨在避免较大的层主导共享表示。该方法针对减少FLOPs却未必降低实际延迟的问题，因为用多个小矩阵运算替代一次大矩阵运算，可能抵消压缩带来的收益。

title.en: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt Uses Speculative Decoding for Local Agents
title.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt以投机解码加速本地智能体

papers.authors: NVIDIA, Adi Margolin, Aditya Malte, et al.

summary.en: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB further post-trains Gemma-4-E4B-it for conversational and tool-using agents and includes a DFlash draft model. The authors report 2.74× per-user decode speed with DFlash versus decoding without speculation at concurrency one, and 1.21× the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size one. These are distinct baselines and single-user or single-batch conditions, so the figures should not be read as general serving-throughput gains.
summary.zh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB在Gemma-4-E4B-it基础上进一步后训练，面向对话和工具调用智能体，并配套DFlash草稿模型。作者报告，在并发数为1时，使用DFlash的单用户解码速度为不采用投机解码时的2.74倍；在批大小为1时，生成吞吐量为采用MTP的Gemma-4-E4B-it的1.21倍。两项结果对应不同基线，且均为单用户或单批次条件，不能直接视为普遍适用的服务吞吐增益。

title.en: Latent Lattice Models Add Persistent Computational States
title.zh: 潜变量格点模型引入跨词元持续存在的计算状态

papers.authors: Shivam Duggal, Zongze Wu, William T. Freeman, et al.

summary.en: Latent Lattice Language Models add per-layer recurrent latent streams that persist across tokens and condition attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation and decoding. After training on 20 billion FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406-million-parameter model reduced validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 versus a parameter-matched Transformer. The architecture changes the state and computation that inference hardware must support, but the reported quality gain does not establish a latency or energy improvement.
summary.zh: 潜变量格点语言模型在各层增加跨词元持续存在的循环潜变量流，用于调节注意力、KV缓存写入、MLP计算和解码。在200亿个FineWeb-Edu词元上训练后，一个4.06亿参数模型的验证困惑度从参数量相当的Transformer的15.41降至14.40。这一架构改变了推理硬件需要支持的状态和计算方式，但所报告的质量提升并不等于已证明延迟或能耗改善。
